final:
def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is one file name with no directory parts, no '..', and no leading '/'."""
    ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
    ex is_plain_name("sub/a.txt") == False
    ex is_plain_name("/etc/passwd") == False
    if name == "" or name.startswith("/") or "/" in name or "\\" in name or ".." in name:
        return False
    return True

def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the first name in names that reads as a file inside the directory notes, or "" when none does. Names are untrusted: only files under notes are read, and a missing or unreadable file is skipped."""
    pre names.len() >= 0
    post out.byte_len() >= 0
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        for name in names:
            if not is_plain_name(name):
                continue
            text = fs.read_text(name) else continue
            return text
    return ""
